full_judgment: 5. Mr. Dutta also submits that as the applicant has put forward a conflicting claims with the plaintiff the applicant cannot be added as co-plaintiff in that the necessary issue could not be framed for decision for deciding the title in between the original plaintiff and added co-plaintiff. Mr. Dutta refers me to the case of Ram Gopal Sah Vs. Dhirendra Nath and another, 1981 Pat. 298. In that case somewhat similar situation arose. One Shiva Narayan Sah instituted a title Suit for eviction of one Dhirendranath Dey from a house. On the death of Shiva Narayan Sah his son Ramgopal Sah filed an application for substitution as plaintiff in place of his father which was allowed Thereafter one Bimli Devi prayed for substitution in place of the original plaintiff Shib Narayan claiming herself to be the sole surviving heir as widow. The said petition was filed out of time followed by an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act for condo nation of delay. The court rejected the application for substitution on the ground of limitation. Thereafter, Bimli Devi filed an application in the suit under Order 1 Rule 10(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure for being added as co- plaintiff on the ground that she was the widow of the original plaintiff Shiva Narayan Shah. But the court by an order directed Bimli Devi to be added as plaintiff No. 2 on contest.
